body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> While the most-talked-about categories of this year's CES is Green IT, Beone CNR (www.beonecnr.com) is drawing the attention of visitors with the company's eco-friendly packing materials and showcased its mobile phone packing and gift box with only paper at CES 2010.
They has developed and produced about 400 kinds of mobile phone packing together with the wireless business department of Samsung Electronics.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
